# Drive

> A Finder drive for people and their agents: plain files in object storage,
> mounted with stock rclone, and billed at 2¢ per GB-month by the minute. The
> monthly bill never passes max($12, $8 × TB stored): a flat $12 up to 1.5 TB,
> then $8 for each TB after. $1 of storage is free every month, no card needed.
> Rate and ceiling in one line: 2¢ per GB, billed by the minute. Never more than $12 a TB, and $8 a TB once you pass 1.5 TB.

Drive is a mounted folder (macOS and Linux) where your files live in object
storage; what is on your disk is the parts you have opened, held in a cache
capped at 20G with 1G of your disk always kept free. Libraries bigger than the
laptop open on demand. Agents read and write the same files through the folder, the
MCP filesystem server, or the S3 API, each with its own scoped key.

## Pricing

- Rate: 2¢ per GB per month, billed by the minute, pay only for what you store.
- Bill ceiling: 2¢ per GB, billed by the minute. Never more than $12 a TB, and $8 a TB once you pass 1.5 TB.
  The monthly bill is min(metered, max($12, $8 × TB stored)) less the $1 free,
  never below zero, TB measured to the GB, so the cap is a flat $12 up to
  1.5 TB and only then rises at $8 a TB.
- Free: $1 free every month, no card needed to start. That is about 50 GB of
  storage each month, and a card is only needed to go past it. It comes off the
  bill as a dollar line, after the ceiling and the downloads.
- Downloads: free up to 3× what you store each month, then 1¢ per GB.
- Version history: not in version 1.
- No plan sizes and no fixed plans: you are billed for the GB you store, so a
  1 TB drive kept 60% full bills $12 a month ($12 of storage, less the $1).

Worked examples, each the amount charged after the $1 free:

- 800 GB kept all month = $12 ($12 of storage)
- 1.6 TB = $12.80 ($12.80 of storage)
- 2 TB = $16 ($16 of storage, against Space $27)
- 5 TB = $40 ($40 of storage, against Space $63)

## What it is

- A drive folder that works in any app. Files stream on demand, so a 5 GB video
  opens without downloading first.
- The cache on your disk is capped at 20G, and 1G of free space is always kept.
  Your disk never fills up; the cache is capped at a size you choose.
  `drive cache` shows the disk in use and the limit, `drive cache --max <size>`
  changes it, and `drive cache --clear` empties it without touching a file still
  waiting to upload. `drive status` shows the same cache use. Files you keep
  offline stay, are never evicted, and count toward that limit.
- Saves upload after the file is closed and appear on the other machines. How
  long a save takes to cross between two real machines is not yet measured.
  The [Benchmarks](https://drive-pricing.nishant345.workers.dev/docs/benchmarks.md)
  page carries the rows that do and do not have a figure.
- A spending cap you set; at the cap the drive goes read-only and nothing is
  deleted.
- Agents read and write freely but cannot permanently delete; a person can undo
  an agent's delete. Branches copy a folder for an agent to work in, then you
  approve or discard the copy.

## Docs

Every page below is one plain-words page about the drive, also served as
Markdown: add `.md` to the address. [llms-full.txt](https://drive-pricing.nishant345.workers.dev/docs/llms-full.txt)
holds all nine in one file.

- [Quickstart](https://drive-pricing.nishant345.workers.dev/docs/quickstart.md): five steps from nothing to a mounted drive.
- [How it works](https://drive-pricing.nishant345.workers.dev/docs/how-it-works.md): plain files, and how the bill is counted.
- [Agents](https://drive-pricing.nishant345.workers.dev/docs/agents.md): `drive init`, and what an agent key cannot do.
- [Pricing and your bill](https://drive-pricing.nishant345.workers.dev/docs/pricing.md): the rate, the ceiling and four worked sizes.
- [FAQ](https://drive-pricing.nishant345.workers.dev/docs/faq.md): the questions we can answer with a measured number.
- [Limits](https://drive-pricing.nishant345.workers.dev/docs/limits.md): what version 1 does not do, in plain words.
- [Benchmarks](https://drive-pricing.nishant345.workers.dev/docs/benchmarks.md): measured speed, including where we lose.
- [Security](https://drive-pricing.nishant345.workers.dev/docs/security.md): who can see your files, and what we cannot claim.
- [Changelog](https://drive-pricing.nishant345.workers.dev/docs/changelog.md): one line per shipped thing.

## Not yet

The drive is not open yet. Sign-ups on the pricing page go to a waitlist.
